title: Inflammatory neuropathy in mouse and primate models of colorectal cancer.
snippet: Colorectal cancer survivors are at increased risk of developing neurological issues, particularly peripheral neuropathy and chronic pain. Although pre-existing neuropathy is a risk factor for chronic pain, tumor-induced neuropathy has not been firmly established in pre-clinical models. title: Peritoneal ovarian cancer growth in the omentum proceeds independently of mature adipocytes.
snippet: The omentum, a specialized adipose tissue within the peritoneum, is a primary niche of ovarian cancer dissemination. Omental adipocytes are widely thought to promote tumor growth by supplying lipids, supported in part by studies using global FABP4 deficiency.
